questions.prompt: 본문에서 도시 생활의 단점으로 가장 마지막에 든 것은?
questions.note: 'What is more, public transportation is sometimes crowded and dirty' · 'Last of all, despite all the crowds, it is still possible to feel very lonely' — 마지막은 외로움

questions.prompt: 본문에서 도시 생활의 단점으로 가장 먼저 든 것은?
questions.note: 'For one thing ... unless it is very well-paid, you will not be able to afford many things because living in a city is often very expensive' — 첫째는 비싼 생활비
